The function get_fuel_consumption returns fuel consumption in gallons per mile. So reachable distance = fuel level / fuel consumption. Actually fuel consumption is gallons per mile, so miles per gallon = 1 / consumption. So reachable distance = fuel level / consumption. Let's call get_fuel_level, get_fuel_consumption. Then compare to 450. If reachable, set navigation. If not, just answer no. Also we might need to check if fuel tank capacity is enough? Not necessary. Just check current fuel level. So we need to call get_fuel_level and get_fuel_consumption. Then compute reachable distance. Then decide. Let's do that.
